scope: Compact immutable EPIC Ego action-window GPU input pack
summary: A compact 832x480 H.264 pack containing both source windows, all six controls, manifests, action state, and robot reference was transferred and hash-verified on the remote host.
evidence: Every source and control window decodes to 124 frames at 24 FPS and 832x480.
Local and remote SHA-256 values matched for every file in the GPU input pack.
lessons: Pre-encoding only the legal H3 windows makes remote transfer auditable and substantially smaller than copying full source trees.
